groups.title: What is mined
groups.note: Which PRs, and which parts of each. Changing these changes the rows, so repos mined before the change differ from the rest.

groups.title: LLM flags
groups.note: The optional explainer-side labels. A different model, scope or limit changes llm_* columns.

groups.title: Feature groups
groups.note: Switch whole groups of columns off. Off means the columns are null, not zero.

groups.title: Re-mining
groups.note: Off by default. A re-mine drops a repo's finished rows before it mines them again.

groups.title: Run tracking
groups.note: How closely the team follows a run. Changes no rows, only how often the trace reaches the store.

groups.title: Split and files
groups.note: Fixed for this split: changing them moves repos between PCs or renames files, and PCs could overlap or lose rows. Plan a new split from the miner's TUI instead.

settings.label: Skip PRs merged in the last N days
settings.help: skip PRs merged in the last N days (default 90, 0 = off)

settings.label: Cap on PRs per repo
settings.help: Keep only the newest N PRs of each repo. Empty means no cap.

settings.label: Mine each repo's whole history
settings.help: Every closed PR of each repo, not a date window or a cap. Cannot be combined with a window or a cap.

settings.label: Window start
settings.help: date window start YYYY-MM-DD

settings.label: Window end
settings.help: date window end YYYY-MM-DD

settings.label: History lead-in (days)
settings.help: history lead-in days

settings.label: What the PR cap counts
settings.help: What the PR cap counts: every PR, or only PRs from outside contributors. Only matters with a window and a cap.

settings.label: Closed-unmerged PRs and merge-outcome labels
settings.help: Also mine closed-unmerged PRs and add the merge-outcome labels. Off gives breakage rows only.

settings.label: Cap on unmerged rows per repo
settings.help: cap unmerged rows per repo (default: the window's real mix)

settings.label: Capture PR snapshots
settings.help: capture what PR snapshots need (default on)

settings.label: Historical CI-fail rate (slow, uses the GitHub quota)
settings.help: Reads every workflow run back to 2019 for the CI-fail rate. Hours on a big repo, and it uses the GitHub quota.

settings.label: SZZ bug tracing
settings.help: Finds the commits that introduced bugs later fixed. Slow; cached after the first run.

settings.label: Skip deep per-file features above N files
settings.help: a PR touching more than N files skips the per-file deep features (blame, line history, scanners) instead of stalling the repo (default 300; 0 = never skip)

settings.label: Model
settings.help: e.g. sonnet, opus, haiku

settings.label: Backend
settings.help: LLM backend for the flags (default: LLM_BACKEND, else claude_cli)

settings.label: Which rows get LLM calls
settings.help: rows that get LLM calls: training = outside contributors (not bots) plus a 5% sample of the rest (default); all = every row

settings.label: Share of other rows still sent (%)
settings.help: With the scope set to training, the share of other rows still sent to the LLM (default 5).

settings.label: When the LLM reads a close reason
settings.help: other_only: ask the LLM only when the rules find no close reason (default); always: every unmerged PR with human activity

settings.label: Diff size sent (characters)
settings.help: cap on the diff sent to the LLM after lockfiles and generated files are cut (default 25000)

settings.label: Context lines around each change
settings.help: context lines around each change in the diff sent to the LLM (default 1)

settings.label: Re-mine stale repos at start
settings.help: At start, drop and mine again any repo this PC finished with an older miner or with blame failing. Leave it off to keep finished rows as they are.

settings.label: Live run tracking
settings.help: Every PC uploads its run trace to the store every 10 seconds instead of every 15 minutes, so the store's log search, Loki and Airflow follow the run as it goes. It adds a small upload per PC and changes no row.

settings.label: Repos file
settings.help: file with one GitHub URL per line (# comments allowed)

settings.label: Only this domain
settings.help: mine only repos tagged [domain: NAME] in the repos file

settings.label: Split balances by
settings.help: What the split balances between PCs: repos' commit counts or PR counts. Every PC must use the same value.

settings.label: Output file
settings.help: single output dataset (rows appended, deduped)

settings.label: Output name prefix
settings.help: text put before the output file's name; placeholders {pc} {n} {host} {date}

settings.label: Output name suffix
settings.help: text put after the output file's name (before the extension), replacing the automatic pc tag; same placeholders
